blocks.text: Balcony App 3.0 is built for the places inspections actually happen: the far end of the yard, the back of a trailer, the dock with no signal.
Inspections work offline. Start, fill in and save a full inspection with no connection, and it syncs on its own when you're back online.
Photos upload faster, in the background, and pick up where they left off if the connection drops.
Every inspection can be a signed report, showing who signed it and when.
We're rolling 3.0 out over the next week, so you may see the update a few days after your teammates.
Thank you to the 41 people who tested the beta. Your crash reports, notes from the yard and honest feedback shaped this release, and a few of you found bugs we'd never have hit on our own.
Questions or problems? Send us a note from Settings > Help in the app.
Angela: first pass, mostly to get it on the page. Cut anything you like, and fix the tone if it sounds too much like me.
